Title: StampApiSubscriptionImpact
Description:
Dashboard link https://aka.ms/antaresdashboard?stampName=[stampName]

GeoMaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/[cloud]%2520Geomaster%2520Check

High API failure rate at stamp. 

If the API failures are caused by the high CPU usage on the Hosting DB or if the Hosting DB is not available please use this TSG to investigate and mitigate:

TSG: SQL investigations - High CPU usage on Hosting or Geomaster database (Web view)

If no progress then involve the incident manager. If still unable to mitigate then involve AntMgmtServicing primary on-call.


If this is happening because the stamp suddenly started throwing 409s, use this TSG --> TSG: Stamp API Impact because of 409s (Web view)

PrimaryKustoQuery.Title: Primary kusto query
PrimaryKustoQuery.KustoQuery:
AntaresAdminControllerEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(30m) and EventId == 40006 
| where UserAgent != "StampPollingManager/1.0"
| where UserAgent !contains "Microsoft.Web.Hosting.Administration.GeoSyncService.Sql.exe"
| where EventStampName  !contains "MSFTINT" 
| extend StampType = column_ifexists("EventStampType", SourceMoniker)
| where StampType !contains "Mini" and SourceMoniker !contains "mini"
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(StatusCode >=500 or StatusCode == 429), conflictFailed = countif(StatusCode == 409) by EventStampName, SubscriptionId, SourceNamespace
| extend availability = ((total - failed) * 100.0) / total, cAvailability =  ((total - failed - conflictFailed) * 100.0) / total
| summarize totalSubs = count(), failedSubs = countif(availability<50), cFailedSubs = countif(cAvailability<50) by EventStampName, SourceNamespace 
| extend SubscriptionImpact = failedSubs * 100.0 / totalSubs, SubImpactWith409AsFailures = cFailedSubs * 100.0 / totalSubs 
| where totalSubs > 50 
| where (SubscriptionImpact > 10 or SubImpactWith409AsFailures > iif(SourceNamespace == "WAWS", 20, 50))
| extend CorrelationIdOverride = "StampAPIAlert"
    , titlePrefix = iif(SourceNamespace == "WAWS" and EventStampName !contains "int", "[AppServiceCP][AutoComms],", "[AppServiceCP],")
    , MonitorId = strcat(SourceNamespace, iif(EventStampName contains "int", "Not", ""), "ApiAutoPost")

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: Hosting Database CPU for 6 hours
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: DBStatsFiveMinuteTable | where TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) and DatabaseName == "hosting" and CounterName == "Avg CPU Percent" | where Source=="Primary" | where EventStampName == "{EventStampName}" | project EndTimeStamp, CounterValue | distinct *

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: Availability 6 hours
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: AntaresAdminControllerEvents | where EventStampName == "{EventStampName}" and TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) and EventId == 40006 | extend Ok=iif(StatusCode<500 and StatusCode != 408,100.0,0.0) | summarize avg(Ok) by bin(TIMESTAMP, 1m)

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: Controller CPU 6 hours
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: StatsCounterFiveMinuteTable | where EventStampName == "{EventStampName}" and TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) | where Role == "ControllerRole" | where CounterName contains "Total" and CounterName contains "Processor Time" | order by TIMESTAMP desc | summarize avg(CounterValue) by bin(TIMESTAMP, 5m)

SecondaryKustoQueries.Title: Stamp Exceptions
SecondaryKustoQueries.KustoQuery: AntaresAdminControllerEvents | where TIMESTAMP > ago(6h) and EventStampName == "{EventStampName}" and Level == 2 | project TIMESTAMP , EventMessage, Exception, EventStampName | summarize ExceptionCount = count(), SqlExceptionCount = countif(Exception contains "SqlException") by bin(TIMESTAMP, 1m)
